meta.title: Chat
meta.description: Chat with the AI version of {name}: ask about his background, projects and passions.

hero.title: Talk with {name}’s AI
hero.intro: Ask Rominou, the guide, anything: he's {name}'s AI version. He answers in writing and can also show you around the site.

notice: Rominou is an AI, so he can make mistakes. For reliable info, email <link>{email}</link>.
welcome: Hi, I'm Rominou, the guide and {name}'s AI version! Ask me anything about my background, my job or my travels.

composer.label: Your message to Rominou
composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line.

errors.unavailable: Rominou is taking a break right now. Write to {name} directly:
errors.rate_limited: Easy there! That's a lot of messages at once. Try again in a minute.
errors.daily_limit: Rominou has talked a lot today and will be back tomorrow. Meanwhile, write to {name}:
errors.forbidden: Your request was blocked by the anti-bot protection. Reload the page or write to {name}:
errors.generic: Oops, something went wrong. Try again, or write to {name}:
